The [[Beastlings]] are supporting [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPCs]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are the young offspring of the [[Bell Beast]].

== In-Game Events ==
In [[Act 3]], after defeating the [[Bell Eater]], the Bell Beast lets out a long call to teach [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] the [[Beastling Call]]. This causes four Beastlings to emerge and start singing alongside their mother. 
When playing the Call, depending on how much room there is, one or two Beastlings will emerge from the ground and bring Hornet to the [[Bellway]] which currently houses the Bell Beast.

After obtaining the call, two to three Beastlings will emerge alongside their mother in any Bellway Hornet travels to.

== Trivia ==
* There is [[Cut_Content_(Silksong)/Text#Bell Beast|cut Needolin dialogue]] for the Bell Beast fight referencing the Beastlings. Without this reference in the final game, it is unclear whether the Beastlings were born before the fight or not.
* The Beastlings can be attacked like their mother, causing her to purr. However, unlike their mother, they take actual knockback from Hornet's swings.
** In some Bellways, like the one in [[Shellwood]], this knockback can be used to push them into environmental hazards or water. This causes them to safely emerge from the ground.
